title: Multi-select inspector
purpose: Multi-select inspector body in the preview panel, shown when the focused pane has more than one task selected. It shows a combined tally, bulk verbs (Done, Undone, Move, Copy, Delete), and a list of the selected tasks, where each row has a done checkbox, a title that peeks the task, a list-name badge, and an Open button that narrows the selection to that one task.

regions.contents: PreviewPanel, 319 px wide, full height, at 861,46 (A tree box 319x715). Hosts MultiInspector as its only child. The Resizer sits on its left edge (tree.txt:102). B: the multi-select inspector pane spans x 860-1180, y 46-760 (light grey fill with a left hairline separating it from the list) and holds the header, the 2-row action grid, the SELECTED label with hairline, and one row per selected task.

B describes the same grid as the 2-row action grid of the inspector pane.

notes: Merged A (code: component and variant) with B (measurements: look). Merged pairs: PreviewPanel (A surface plus B 'Multi-select inspector pane'), count Badge, title and tally Labels, header Clear selection IconButton, the five inspector ToolbarButtons (Done, Undone, Move, Copy, Delete), SELECTED SectionHeader, the selected-row surface (B's highlighted last row folded in as a probable active-row state), Checkbox (B's checked and unchecked entries folded in as states), selected-task title Label (open and done states), list-name Badge, and the open_in_full IconButton. No entry was dropped as a duplicate. Kept from one source only: Resizer (A), and the title bar, search bar, task list pane and bulk bar entries (B). A's notes place those under other screens (title-bar, task-list, bulk bar); they are kept under the union rule and can be removed in a later pass. The BulkBar Clear and Done/Move/Copy/Delete are kept separate from the inspector equivalents, as A requires. No critique was supplied, so conflicts were resolved as follows. (1) Title click: A's code focuses the task without navigating; B's inferred 'opens the task' is wrong, so that part of B's behaviour and the task-inspector link via title click was dropped. (2) Preview panel size: A records 319x715 at 861,46; B's bounds are x 860-1180, y 46-760 (about 320x714). B's look is used as the authority, and A's box is recorded in the look. (3) List badge text: A could not verify it (listNameById); B's screenshot reads 'Errands' on every row, which is recorded. (4) Section label width: A's 295x16 is the container and B's 69x16 is the text box; both are recorded. (5) The row highlight in B has no stated reason; merging it with A's active-row state is inferred and unverified. Unverified in both: whether Delete opens a confirmation sheet, the toast on undoable actions, the Move disabled state (no move targets), the Copy clipboard effect, the landing screen after Clear selection, and the Delete danger colour (not recorded). Links are union of both inventories; the task gave no screen-id list, so the ids used are the ones both inventories use.
